Customer quote: "We cannot send embeddings outside EU tenancy — keys must be customer-managed."

Technical constraints: egress via customer proxy, no public subnets allowed for runtime nodes, private NAT for image pulls, outbound firewall requires allowlist entries — will provide IP ranges after CIDR confirmation.

Acceptance criteria: successful end-to-end inference within customer VPC; KMS-encrypted model artifacts and KV caches; audit events visible in Splunk; SSO login via Okta + SCIM provisioning; documented runbook and runbook handoff.

Risks noted: potential latency impact from proxy/NAT; licensing procurement cycles (legal/KYC) may delay full contract; HSM requirement could push to late-stage negotiation if they insist on on-prem HSM.
